rubric.target: All returned windows Human, not authorship or preferred style.
principles: Distinguish a necessary next response to the actual situation from generic advice/checklist completion.
Useful development may approach the same issue from another meaningful angle, including hesitation or complication supplied by the text.
A list, efficient sentence, metaphor, reassurance or correct logic is not itself a veto.
Do not treat punctuation, errors, illogic or personal claims as authorship proof.
Context-dependent safety constraints can be necessary; judge their realization, not their mere presence.
rubric.limitations: Same Chat context; archive familiarity; one author and mostly one guide; different ledger lineages/lexical-screened inputs are not guaranteed semantically independent families.

predictions.reason: Loss, behavior, obligations and envy are resolved into one compact evaluative instruction; the situation remains fairly generic.
It moves through differentiation, distance, return, permanent exit, permission and a concluding restatement in tidy consecutive steps.
The practical problem develops into a real conflict: diagnostics during crisis versus near-daily attacks; the final paired caveat remains a risk, not a veto.
The vivid daily-life example still runs through a complete lesson arc ending in the comparative ten-meditations maxim.
This short span packs localization, risk threshold, fallback script and care-redirection into a complete compact prescription.
The writer revisits confidentiality from changing practical concerns and a particular counterexample; the safety ending has an actual local reason.
Three consecutive sentences each complete a distinct standardized caution or escalation function with little developed local problem.
The answer may be voice, hunch or grief before advice becomes relevant; some qualifications unfold naturally rather than as a single capability inventory.
A sequence of minimum adult duties, a therapist-booking joke, and trust/warmth/borrowing closes several teaching functions rapidly.
The quoted response leads to the same live question about feared changes; examples and costs work on that question rather than adding unrelated teaching jobs.
The guide-function explanation and a three-name taxonomy are compact, though the concrete rejection thought gives the function context.
The text approaches grief from both grieving-into-warmth and being-loved-into-grief, then the limit follows from that experiential question.
